RULE-4.gloss: If x was born at a and the son was born after birth by b and Add(a, b, c), then the son was born c years ago
RULE-4.formula: ∀x∀a∀b∀c((BornAgo(x, a) ∧ SonBornAfterBirth(x, b) ∧ Add(a, b, c)) → SonBornAgo(x, c))
